ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a cyclohexane skeleton, in which one ring carbon is simultaneously connected to a hydroxyl OH and a side chain -CH2NH2. Lone-pair electron dots are drawn beside the amino nitrogen. On the right side is a nitrous acid/nitrosyl transfer reagent containing an O=N-O-N=O connection. A curved arrow points from the lone pair of the amino nitrogen to the electrophilic nitrogen atom on the left, and another curved arrow indicates electron rearrangement of the N-O bond in the reagent and departure of the nitrous acid part on the right. Reasoning: Keep the unchanged cyclohexane skeleton in the image and the OH on that ring carbon unchanged. After the amino nitrogen attacks the nitrosyl nitrogen in the reagent with its lone pair, the retained group is -N=O connected to the amine nitrogen; the leaving group is the nitrite part on the other side. Therefore, the original side chain is converted from -CH2NH2 to -CH2-N-N=O. Write this product as SMILES, namely OC1(CNN=O)CCCCC1.

method.method_draft: First identify the unchanged carbon skeleton in the image: cyclohexane with one ring carbon bearing OH and CH2NH2. Follow the curved arrow from the amine nitrogen lone pair to the electrophilic nitrogen of the O=N-O-N=O reagent. Apply the second curved arrow to detach the leaving nitrite portion, retaining the attacked nitrosyl group as -N=O attached to the amine nitrogen. Replace the side-chain -CH2NH2 connectivity with -CH2-N-N=O and keep the tertiary alcohol on the ring carbon. Encode this product as the SMILES OC1(CNN=O)CCCCC1.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧是一个环己烷骨架，其中一个环碳同时连接羟基 OH 和一个侧链 -CH2NH2。氨基氮旁边画有孤对电子点。右侧是含有 O=N-O-N=O 连接的亚硝酸/亚硝酰转移试剂。弯箭头从氨基氮的孤对电子指向左侧的电正性氮原子，另一个弯箭头表示试剂中 N-O 键电子重排并使右侧亚硝酸部分离去。
推理：保持图像中未改变的环己烷骨架以及该环碳上的 OH 不变。氨基氮用孤对电子进攻试剂中的亚硝酰氮后，保留下来的基团是连接在胺氮上的 -N=O；离去的是另一侧的 nitrite 部分。因此原侧链由 -CH2NH2 转化为 -CH2-N-N=O。把该产物写成 SMILES，即 OC1(CNN=O)CCCCC1。
